# Wiktionary

> > A free multilingual dictionary covering words, symbols, proper nouns, and linguistic features across hundreds of languages with detailed etymologies, pronunciations, and Unicode references.

Wiktionary is a collaborative dictionary project that documents vocabulary from all languages, including special characters, punctuation marks, currency symbols, and geographic names. Each entry provides comprehensive linguistic information including IPA pronunciation, etymology, translations, and character encoding details for Unicode symbols.

## Key Topics

- Unicode character encoding
- International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA)
- Etymology and word origins
- Typography and punctuation
- Currency symbols
- Translingual symbols
- Latin-1 Supplement
- Proper nouns and geography
- Multilingual definitions
- Character references (HTML/XML)
- Catalan language
- Old Norse etymology
- Quotation marks and guillemets
- Pronunciation guides
- Linguistic morphology

## Currency and Mathematical Symbols

- [$ - Dollar Sign](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/$): Dollar sign currency symbol with Unicode character encoding reference
- [£ - Pound Sterling](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C2%A3): Pound sterling currency symbol with Unicode and Latin-1 details
- [± - Plus-Minus](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C2%B1): Plus-minus mathematical symbol for margin of error notation

## Typography and Punctuation

- [« - Left Guillemet](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C2%AB): Left guillemet quotation mark with Unicode and HTML references
- [» - Right Guillemet](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C2%BB): Right guillemet quotation mark (U+00BB) with XML references
- [» « - Guillemet Pair](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C2%BB_%C2%AB): Guillemet punctuation pair for quotation marks in typography
- [­ - Soft Hyphen](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C2%AD): Soft hyphen Unicode control character (U+00AD) definition
- [º - Masculine Ordinal](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C2%BA): Masculine ordinal indicator for Romance languages typography

## Diacritics and Phonetic Symbols

- [ˉ - Macron](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C2%AF): Macron phonetic symbol for IPA tone marking and prosody
- [À - A with Grave](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C3%80): Latin letter A with grave accent for Catalan orthography

## Geographic Proper Nouns

- [Àisia - Asia (Scottish Gaelic)](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C3%80isia): Scottish Gaelic proper noun for Asia continent
- [Ànglia - Anglia (Catalan)](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C3%80nglia): Catalan proper noun for Anglia from Latin etymology
- [Àustria - Austria (Catalan/Occitan)](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C3%80ustria): Catalan/Occitan proper noun for Austria in Central Europe
- [Áland - Åland Islands](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C3%81land): Faroese/Icelandic proper noun for Åland from Old Norse
- [Ártico - Arctic (Galician/Portuguese)](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C3%81rtico): Galician/Portuguese proper noun for Arctic region
- [Árpádhalom - Hungarian Village](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C3%81rp%C3%A1dhalom): Hungarian village name in Csongrád-Csanád with declension table

## Personal Names

- [Ása - Given Name](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C3%81sa): Faroese/Icelandic female given name from Old Norse etymology

## Optional

- [$cientology - Slang Term](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/$cientology): Derogatory slang term for Scientology with dollar sign spelling
- [%iles - Plural Form](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%25iles): Plural noun form dictionary entry for English grammar
